findings.what: Mask transported via undocumented params["mask"] side-channel (read line 157, outside ParamSpec); a shape-mismatched mask is silently dropped (mask=None) instead of erroring.
findings.why: resolve_params rejects unknown keys, so the mask can never arrive through normal parameter resolution; the only way in is post-hoc injection (as the test helper _apply_mask does). Lines 160-161 silently discard a wrong-sized mask -> a caller asking for a mask gets a fully-unmasked result with no signal. Sibling effect L14 (displace.py _mask_weights) transports the mask as keyword-only and raises ValueError on size mismatch. Two effects in the same package now have incompatible mask APIs; the compositor (L20) must special-case one, or one silently loses its mask. Contract §14 is silent (E1), but silent-drop on mismatch is a latent wrong-result defect, not a documented convention.
findings.fix: Accept mask as keyword-only mirroring displace.py and raise ValueError on shape mismatch instead of setting mask=None. If the params-dict channel is kept, validate/raise on mismatch and register an E1 deviation recording the transport choice so L20 reconciles it with displace.

findings.why: Both images are constant (all-ones / all-zeros), so any reordering - including a no-op implementation - yields the identical image and out == img holds. Neither can detect a missing sort. The accepts are actually proven by test_brightness_zero_sorts_every_row_ascending and test_pixels_below_brightness_are_not_sorted.
findings.fix: Replace the all-white/all-black assertions with an image having a non-trivial ordering under the tested key, or drop them as redundant.

findings.what: test_effect_is_deterministic and test_diagonal_is_deterministic assert determinism that holds trivially because rng is never used.
findings.why: The effect ignores its rng argument (stable sort is deterministic by construction), so these tests pass regardless of seed and cannot fail.
findings.fix: Note pixel_sort is intentionally rng-free, or exercise determinism across differing rng values to make the claim meaningful.

findings.fix: Append a trailing newline to both files.

renderer_invariants: N/A — pixel_sort is an effect, not a CellRenderer. Effect-level analogues hold and are tested: output shape preserved, no input mutation, deterministic.
notes: columns(A) == rows(A^T).T is mathematically correct; the literal reading columns(A) == rows(A).T is false (counterexample A=[[2,1],[0,3]] gives columns [[0,1],[2,3]] vs rows.T [[1,0],[2,3]]), so the coder's interpretation honors the contract intent. All six accept items genuinely implemented (27 owned tests pass). i18n label reuse matches the accepted DEV-212 precedent. The mask transport (E1) should be recorded as a deviation and reconciled with L14's displace convention before L20.
